Donegal Nature and wildlife Romantic Free car parking Sunny days Drive or cycle through Malaidh Ghleann Gheis (Glengesh Pass) and stop for a view over Loughros Beg Bay, framed between the steep-sided Ghleann Gheis and Mulmosog mountains. Take in the tree-lined view down the valley with a hot drink from the nearby coffee truck.
